g.text: Only archived historical dose ranges shown; full ranges and control in Appendix H

g.text: Scope: all 7 scenes with an archived cutoff (of 12 planned). Five scenes have no cutoff; all 12 appear in Appendix H.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: ρ uses jointly valid Holding/straight doses within the cutoff; curves use available Holding fits. Missing doses break lines; panel y-scales differ.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Historical cutoffs were outcome-derived, not independently validated operating limits. Equal-duration straight control: median ρ = 0.598 (Appendix H).

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: R² ≥ 0.98 unchanged. Orders are dependent repeats; no confidence intervals or p-values. All scene times are UTC+08.
